verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Alloy can generate transaction-monitoring alerts and investigations, and its marketing mentions "agentic automation" of KYC/AML/fraud checks. Nothing documents an in-product agent that investigates transaction alerts or drafts review notes for an analyst. The agentic-automation line covers running checks, a related but different capability, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes
